title: fix: retain parent links in Incognito forks
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes the missing parent-session link in an Incognito fork after sending a message or refreshing the conversation.

## User Impact

Users can return to an accessible parent from the chat header, including when that parent is outside the current session list. Incognito roster visibility and transcript storage behavior are unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

The header previously searched only the pane’s session list. It now holds a scoped parent descriptor observation through the existing session owner, so renames, deletion, connection changes, and late responses follow the same lifecycle. A failed descriptor read can recover on a later refresh.

## Evidence

Reproduced through the real browser with a live Gateway: the Incognito child lost its header link while Gateway lineage and sidebar ancestry remained correct. The regression fails on the original implementation; the transient-read recovery regression also fails on the first candidate.

Focused tests: 79 passed across parent-session, session-event, session-access, and header suites in 6.81 seconds wall time with `--maxWorkers=1`. After correcting the fixture to use the API’s `true`-or-absent Incognito marker, all four parent-session cases passed again in 4.10 seconds wrapper wall time (524 ms summed case time). The synthetic browser flow verifies the parent is outside `sessions.list`, the repaired breadcrumb is visible, and clicking it navigates to the parent.

Independent review and the current-head ClawSweeper review found no remaining actionable findings. All selected local checks pass after correcting the fixture marker and removing two redundant generic arguments. The final four-case replay passed in 7.23 seconds alongside lint. Full build and strict UI performance checks pass.

Verified on the real Gateway with OpenAI: create an Incognito parent, fork it, send a child follow-up, cold-reload the browser, click the surviving parent breadcrumb, rename the parent, and return to the child. Both replies are correct; the renamed parent link remains available and the other pane’s unsent draft is preserved. Read-only Gateway checks confirmed the parent has two messages, the child has four with the inherited prefix intact, both remain excluded from the durable roster, and no matching rows exist in the four scoped durable session/transcript tables. Twenty-one durable conversation/work groups also passed before/after the isolated runtime update. The built source is `a5e819d8`; the final PR differs only by removing two redundant test type arguments, with no production or build-input changes.

The initial local checks caught a type-invalid boolean fixture marker and two unnecessary type arguments; each was corrected and its affected checks replayed. Exact-head CI passed. In CI, the four-case parent-session suite took 1.005 seconds of test execution (1.606 seconds including module scheduling/imports); no failed or repeated execution was observed. Screenshots below use synthetic data only.

![Before: Incognito fork loses its parent breadcrumb](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ea8405a8-7e2e-4171-b761-6766a18eb7c1)

![After: parent breadcrumb remains available outside the session list](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d2bf0e3b-f98d-4a4d-8264-efb38db2074c)
